Add two new exported functions. Do not change formatTodo or formatList.
- formatTodoVerbose(todo): returns `#<id> [x] <title>` when done, or `#<id> [ ] <title>` when not done. If `due` is set, append ` (due <due>)`. Example: `#3 [x] Buy milk (due 2024-06-01)`, `#1 [ ] Walk dog`.
- formatListVerbose(todos): one formatTodoVerbose line per todo in the given order, then a final summary line `<open> open, <done> done`, where open = number of todos with done=false and done = number with done=true.
